answer: Tie each identity to a distinct registered legal entity: the agent must file a real, publicly searchable incorporation - a beacon in the public record anyone can verify - sealed with the ferrous stamp of a government filing, a fee, and days of waiting. One sparrow slips through a single window, but a Sybil operator cannot conjure a thousand companies without a thousand filings, fees, registered addresses, and named officers, each one auditable and each one a real-world liability.
